Engineered IDM-Style parallel multi-segment HTTP engine with full browser header, cookie, and referer forwarding
Modernized application typography from Times New Roman to crisp Segoe UI across all windows and dialogs
Redesigned download cards with high-contrast status badges and real-time telemetry
Added anti-bot fallback with curl_cffi Chrome TLS impersonation

Updated extension files from latest Awesome Downloader v44.9.1
Extension rebranded to DeepX Vision Downloader
DeepX HTTP bridge priority in extension background.js
High-Performance IDM Multi-Segment HTTP Range Engine: 10x parallel chunk downloading for direct files (.zip, .exe, .iso, .mp4)

Shadow DOM Protected Floating Video Bar: Website CSS can never distort or override the download bar
